properties.notes: Main constraints: Listed Buildings, Ebley Mills Conservation Area, adjoining canal, flood risk Summary: The site is considered to be deliverable for housing within five years. The site is available now and it is suitable for the conversion of existing buildings to a range of uses, including housing, subject to conserving the character of the listed buildings and conservation area.. Current planning application for the conversion of the upper three floors of the historic mill building and 2-storey wing to 6no flats.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
